name: Ridge Outdoor Intl Ltd
summary: Ridge Outdoor International Limited, founded in 1993 and based in Hangzhou, designs and makes fishing tackle equipment, including fishing chairs, bedchairs, rod pods, bags and tents such as bivvies. Its gear supports carp, match, lure, fly and ice fishing. The company was named Ridge International Limited until November 2024 and is a subsidiary of GreatCast International Limited.
